sentences.text: Pietraroiasuchus is a member of the family Hylaeochampsidae, a group of ancient reptiles.

Researchers Buscalioni and colleagues named the genus in 2011 based on fossils from the Pietraroja Plattenkalk formation in the southern Apennines mountains of Italy. The type species is Pietraroiasuchus ormezzanoi.
This animal lived during the Albian stage of the Early Cretaceous, approximately 113.2 to 110.1 million years ago.
